newsitem.title: USA: Prosource sees Q2 earnings falling.
newsitem.headline: Prosource sees Q2 earnings falling.

text.p: ProSource Inc on Monday predicted that earnings for the second quarter ending June 28 would be "significantly lower" than the second quarter of 1996 when the company posted earnings per share of $0.23.
Specifically, the company said earnings could fall by $0.25 to $0.30 per share.

ProSource based its predictions on several adverse factors, including costs associated with an unsuccessful acquisition attempt and the termination of its Arby's contract as well as price increases for vehicle maintenance and weaker-than-expected sales growth.
